Name: Lazy Days
Author: InitiaNovaStreaming
Description:
[size=3]Lazy Days overhauls several game mechanics to remove time pressure from the game.[/size]

[size=5]Clock Speed:[/size]
[size=3]Clock speed in the game defaults to the same rate as real time, 60 seconds in real time per game minute. To fast forward the clock, the player can hold down the comma (",") key. While the key is being held down, the clock speed changes to 1 second in real time per 10 game minutes. This allows the player to manually skip ahead when they are waiting for a specific amount of time to pass.[/size]

[size=5]Freezing Time:[/size]
[size=3]If the player needs to pause the game, they should use the /pause and /resume commands. Allowing the player to move around and interact with the world while time is frozen can cause glitches and unexpected behavior, which is why Lazy Days uses a slow clock speed instead of stopping the clock all together. Since the clock speed has been slowed to an excessive degree, many automatic time freezes have been removed, including freezing time on the inventory screen. This helps the in-game clock keep up with real time and allows the players to use the in-game clock to see how much time has actually passed in real life.[/size]

[size=5]Fishing:[/size]
[size=3]Fishing becomes extremely overpowered when the clock is slowed down. To compensate for this, the clock speed increases to 7 seconds in real time per 10 game minutes while the player is actively waiting for a fish to bite. Fishing is an excellent way to pass the time![/size]

[size=5]The Mines:[/size]
[size=3]In play testing, it was common for players to feel pressured to spend as much energy as possible in the mines, leading to excessively long days of repeatedly mining and clearing inventory. To make sure the mines won't take up the player's entire day, entry into the mines has been limited to once per day.[/size]

[size=5]Configuration:[/size]
[size=3]Many features are configurable. I recommend using the Generic Mod Config Menu mod to make any configuration adjustments. Using the GMCM mod, all features are configurable mid-game without the need to return to the title screen or restart the game.[/size]

[size=5]Compatibility:[/size]

[/list][size=3]Feel free to message me if there are any mods you would like to be compatible, and I will add them to my roadmap.[/size]
